remarks: Welcome to 1283 Hope Street, Unit 4, a spacious two-bedroom townhouse-style condominium ideally located in Stamford's desirable Springdale neighborhood near the New Canaan border.  This bright two-level home features beautiful hardwood floors, recessed lighting, crown molding, and generous living spaces. The large eat-in kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a center island with seating and prep space. It opens naturally to the dining area, while the sun-filled living room provides a welcoming space to relax or gather.  Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms offer excellent closet space along with a full bathroom. In-unit laundry, basement and attic storage, and two parking spaces add valuable convenience and functionality.  Set near the Springdale Metro-North station, shopping, dining, major roadways, and the New Canaan border, this home offers an easy commute and access to the best of Stamford and the surrounding area.  Come check it out!
